posts.meta_description:
165K likes, 819 comments - vindiesel on October 28, 2026: "Brooklyn kid in the uniform, WWII… wrote a letter home to his old man…
He never got to send it.

29 years ago I came home from playing him. Paramount had just wrote my first check, as an actor. I’d been to Cannes, been to Sundance as a director… but never paid.
With it I bought a ticket to Europe for my mother… her first.

Funny thing about Caparzo. He died helping a kid nobody told him to help.
That’s who my mom is... her mantra. 
The best way to help yourself is to help other people.

I asked her of all the upcoming projects, what she’s excited to see... the finale of course. But also
Riddick. She likes the antihero. Always has.
Kaulder, the new lycanthropes, and Scottish legend lore. 
And Rock ‘Em Sock ‘Em. She knows how  personal that one is…

Talk about multitasking Haha. 

Next year makes thirty since Sundance. She was there in the Park City cold…
Caparzo never got his letter home.
This one’s mine.

Hope to make you proud...".
